description: Phase 2 matching rubric. Every number here is a proposal to be calibrated against the first days of real data, not a truth. The version travels in every MatchResult so a result can always be reproduced. See ADR-0005.

tolerances.typicalFeeRateNotes: Measured, not chosen: across the 53 settlements of Jan-Apr 2026 the implied deduction rate has a median of 4.361% and a standard deviation of 0.090 points. This is that centre plus or minus one deviation, and it contains 41 of the 53. Outside it the gap is still plausible, which is what impliedFeeRateBand is for, but it is no longer typical and the score says so.
tolerances.impliedFeeRateNotes: The admissibility band, and a gate: outside it the difference between the gross and the credit cannot be a commission, so AMOUNT_MISMATCH fires and the candidate is discarded. It comes from the statutory structure rather than from fitting. Retencion en la fuente is a flat 1.5% by law and is always present; the rest is the gateway commission plus 19% VAT on it, so a commission between 2.1% and 2.95% produces a total between 4% and 5%. Measured afterwards against Jan-Apr 2026 the observed totals run 4.299% to 4.687% — implied commissions of 2.35% to 2.68% — which leaves about 0.30 points of margin at each edge. Kept as it was; the data supports it.

wompi.cutoffNotes: Fitted against Jan-Apr 2026, not documented by Wompi. A sweep from 14:00 to midnight peaks sharply at 21:00 Bogota: 50 of 56 batches then close against the bank within the statutory 3-6% deduction band, versus 36 of 54 assuming midnight. Re-fit it if the gateway changes; it is one number in one file precisely so that is cheap.

channelNotes: Patterns say how a channel names itself on a bank statement. This is reconciliation policy, not an ingestion fact: config/descriptors.json records the counterparty a descriptor names, and this decides whether that name is the channel we expected. Keeping them apart is what stops DESCRIPTOR_MATCH from scoring a conclusion ingestion already reached.

statutoryRates.note: Colombian VAT on services and withholding at source on card sales. Law, not gateway policy — which is why the deduction split needs only one unknown. See ADR-0013.

weightNotes: The amount check is graded because it carries most of the information. AMOUNT_EXACT (50) needs a breakdown the source stated. IMPLIED_FEE_TYPICAL (40) is the strongest a derived breakdown can reach: the gap sits on the rate this channel actually charges. IMPLIED_FEE_IN_BAND (25) is plausible but not typical. A derived settlement therefore tops out at 115 of 125 rather than at 125, which is the honest ceiling: nobody verified the commission, they only found it unsurprising.
disqualifyingNotes: Gates, not points. A credit whose amount cannot be explained, that names someone else, or that landed outside the window is not a weak match — it is a different payment. Before this existed a batch of $4.842.430 was matched to a credit of $257.940 and reported as AMBIGUOUS, because the date and descriptor points alone cleared the floor.
